args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1 to production, the service failed health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 18%. Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. Action taken: rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions. After the rollback, all regions run v2.3.0, the service is healthy, and the error rate is 0.2%. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying it.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident (INC-0001), which paged on-call.

- **Problem:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate, v2.3.1-rc, had also been unhealthy in staging before it went to production.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, all three regions run v2.3.0, health checks pass and the error rate is 0.2%.
- **Incident:** It describes the failure and the rollback, and asks for the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure to be found before it's deployed again. No other incident was open, so this isn't a duplicate.
